que_es_porcentaje: What is it? Minimum percentage of pixels that must change in the image to consider that there is movement.
recomendacion_porcentaje: Recommendation: 0.5% for normal detection | 0.3% for high sensitivity | 1.0% to ignore slight movements
que_es_varianza: What is it? Algorithm sensitivity to distinguish between background and movement. Controls how much a pixel must differ from the background to be considered 'in motion'.
recomendacion_varianza: Recommendation: 16 for standard detection | 8-12 for high sensitivity | 25-40 to ignore light changes
que_es_enfriamiento: What is it? Minimum time that must pass between two consecutive detections. Prevents creating multiple clips for the same event.
recomendacion_enfriamiento: Recommendation: 8 sec (8000ms) for normal events | 3-5 sec for fast movements | 10-15 sec for long events

explicacion_zona_hora:
1. Upload a video: Select any video from your camera to use as reference.
2. Draw the area: Drag the mouse over the image to mark where the date/time appears in your videos.
3. Save: The system will use this area to automatically extract the real date and time from each detected event.

💡 Important: This configuration applies to all videos from the same camera. You only need to set it up once.
